text: 【大连万达商管等被执行2.5亿】天眼查法律诉讼信息显示，近日，大连万达商业管理集团股份有限公司等新增一条被执行人信息，执行标的2.5亿余元，执行法院为江苏省南通市中级人民法院。该公司成立于2002年9月，法定代表人为陈洪涛，注册资本约271.6亿人民币，经营范围包括商业综合体管理服务、非居住房地产租赁、物业管理等。
text_en: 【Dalian Wanda Commercial Management and others hit with 250 million yuan in enforcement actions】Tianyancha legal litigation data shows that recently, Dalian Wanda Commercial Management Group Co., Ltd. and others were added as subjects of enforcement with an execution amount of over 250 million yuan, with the enforcement court being the Intermediate People's Court of Nantong, Jiangsu Province. The company was established in September 2002, with legal representative Chen Hongtao, registered capital of approximately 27.16 billion yuan, and its business scope includes commercial complex management services, non-residential real estate leasing, and property management, among others.
